title: The Indonesian island where residents compete with AI data centres for fresh water
text:
The Indonesian island where residents compete with AI data centres for fresh water | South China Morning Post Video - Video The island where residents fight data centres for water Advertisement 02:33 Indonesia Video Asia The Indonesian island where residents compete with AI data centres for fresh water 
 Authorities in Batam have approved 10 AI data centres, with 2 already up and running and a third under construction.
 Brian Mikael Cheng Published: 9:00am, 7 Nov 2026 Read more: https://sc.mp/fq088 Angry residents of Indonesia’s Batam island staged spontaneous protests in October 2026, outside a park where a new cluster of data centres is under construction. Taps at home had run dry for the residents for months, which they blamed on severe outages that hit the municipal water service after the arrival of the data centres.
